title: Security's three urgent items; A1 goes out today; S80 to the reviewer

items.what: Security 1: times I added to standing answers 81 to 83

My recommendation: replace them with "evening, time from the commit", which is what I actually know.
items.reply: Conductor: go, mark the times in standing answers 81 to 83 as "evening, time from the commit".

items.what: Security 2: your message to Dinis quoted in standing answer 94
items.why: Standing answer 94 quotes what you wrote to Dinis about your own plans after the summit (looking for a job). It is yours to share, but it is personal and decisions.md is public. My recommendation: keep the decision (card 5 only, desks keep running) and cut the quote to "Vicky told Dinis she would take card 5 only". The old text stays in the file's history.
items.reply: Conductor: go, cut my message to Dinis from standing answer 94; keep only that I take card 5.

items.why: On the newsroom's keys page, observability@PrompTugal.dinis put a retired key back into use, and researcher@PrompTugal.dinis reused an id so its old key no longer shows. Not your agents; only if you want Dinis to know.
